links.comparator_used: Model outputs predictions for all patients (100% declaration rate), with no confidence-based restriction
links.outcome: Sensitivity and AUC when retaining only the most confident predictions (Metrics by Declaration Rate curves)
links.effect: Limiting predictions to the 93% most confident cases improved sensitivity by 14.3% and AUC by 5.1% (internal validation)
links.tradeoff: Predictions are withheld for the remaining less-confident patients, so there is a trade-off between model performance and the proportion of patients for whom predictions are considered reliable.
links.quote: In internal validation, limiting predictions to the 93% most confident cases improved sensitivity by 14.3% and the AUC by 5.1%.

design_hint: confidence-based deferral of low-confidence predictions (declaration rate thresholds)
